chose: python surface routes through surfaceOfSource's existing fileName param — .py dispatches to a module-private regex scanner
over: a new exported pySurface consumed by signal.ts
because: adapter symbols() counts methods and lacks domains, so reuse would mean filtering plus a second pass anyway; a private function keeps signal.ts byte-identical and adds zero new API surface to the very module that measures surface

chose: underscore prefix is the sole python privacy signal; __all__ is ignored
because: __all__ is assignment-shaped (often built dynamically or extended across lines), so honoring it honestly is not regex-cheap; underscore convention is line-local and matches the adapter's precedent — a public name listed out of __all__ over-counts by at most its own entry, which is the safe direction for an advisory

chose: underscore-prefixed dict tables still contribute domain keys (name withheld from exports); underscore enums/defs/consts count nothing
over: excluding _NAME dict literals wholesale for symmetry with the other underscore rules
because: the TS path counts Record tables whether or not exported precisely because module-local keyed tables are the motivating drift surface; _TABLE = {…} is python's spelling of that same local table, so dropping it would reopen the exact blind spot

chose: deliberately NOT counted for python: annotation-only bindings (x: int), tuple unpacking, dynamically-built dicts/comprehensions, nested multi-line dict keys, enum functional API (Mode = Enum('Mode', …)), conftest.py exclusion
over: chasing each form with looser regexes
because: regex-grade bar is precision over recall — every listed form either lacks a line-local anchor or risks counting garbage (comprehension bodies, nested keys at unknown indents); test-path spellings mirror oracle-domain's test_*.py/_test.py basename regexes exactly so the two python test-detectors cannot drift apart
